primary_scoring_effect: Scoring rules are unchanged, and forecast/draw retention behaviour within the scoring window is unchanged: every scheduled date this benchmark scores falls within 2026-09-04 through 2026-09-12, where amendment 004 already permitted retention, so no scored date gains or loses a sidecar. This amendment is not invisible to the archive -- capture manifests recorded after its adoption list it among the amendments in force, as the append-only chain requires -- but it changes no capture's forecast, draws, timing label or weight. The extension of retention itself reaches only generations certified after the final scheduled date, which the benchmark never selects, weights or scores. The capture dates, mechanical per-date selection, timing-eligibility rule, late-capture limit, weighting, fair CRPS primary metric and its availability condition, the amendment 002 standard WIS formula, the amendment 003 replay fallback, the eight-party set, the final forecast date and the winner hierarchy are all unchanged.
reason: Amendment 004 permitted an exact-draw sidecar for every certified production generation only for the bounded period 2026-09-04 through 2026-09-12, after which amendment 003's prohibition on per-generation sidecars would return. Publication is now two-stage: the immutable generation is certified and pushed, and the website history curve is rendered afterwards. Rendering an already-certified generation without rerunning the authoritative 100000-draw simulation requires that generation's joint draw matrices, because a history point's coalition intervals are computed from joint draws and cannot be recovered from published marginal quantiles. Under amendment 004's boundary that capability would end on 2026-09-13.

replacement_rule.extended_retention: An exact-draw sidecar is retained for every newly certified production generation, with no end date, superseding the '2026-09-04 through 2026-09-12' bound in amendment 004.
replacement_rule.prospective_only: No sidecar is written for any generation that did not export one from its own SimulationResult. The archive's sidecar requirement applies to the generation being certified, not to generations already archived.
replacement_rule.purpose: Operational only: to support rendering of, and recovery to, an already-certified generation without rerunning the authoritative forecast.
replacement_rule.scope: Retention period of the amendment 004 exact-draw sidecar only.
replacement_rule.verified_conditions: Unchanged from amendment 004: exported from the same in-memory SimulationResult used for that publication, and first appearing in the same Git commit as its certified snapshot.

unchanged_rules: Benchmark selection remains one mechanically selected generation per scheduled date.
Sidecars belonging to unselected intraday generations receive no scoring weight.
The frozen cutoff is 23:30:00 Europe/Stockholm, 21:30:00Z during the window, for every scheduled date.
The nine scheduled capture dates, timing-eligibility labels and late-capture limit are untouched.
Campaign weighting is untouched: equal weight per scheduled date and per party within a date.
The fair CRPS primary metric, its availability condition and the amendment 002 standard WIS formula are untouched.
The amendment 003 deterministic replay fallback remains available.
The eight-party set, the final forecast date and the winner hierarchy are untouched.
Existing capture manifests are not modified; manifests recorded after adoption list this amendment among those in force, which records protocol state and alters no captured evidence.
protocol.json and amendments 001 through 006 are not rewritten; the chain is append-only.
